title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space industry is navigating a mix of innovation and regulatory approvals, with propulsion tests and satellite deployments taking center stage. Meanwhile, the hiring landscape is evolving, and budget allocations are hinting at a focus on resilience.

themes.title: Cubesats Get Maneuverable Boost
themes.body: Parabilis is making strides with its propulsion system for cubesats, which could enhance maneuverability in increasingly crowded orbits. This development may set the stage for more agile satellite operations in the future.

themes.title: FCC's Satellite Approvals Continue
themes.body: The FCC's green light for Reflect Orbital's satellite marks another step in the ongoing expansion of commercial space capabilities. This approval underscores the regulatory landscape's role in shaping the competitive dynamics of satellite services.

themes.title: Hiring Dilemmas in Space Sector
themes.body: The space industry is grappling with the paradox of ambitious hiring goals against the backdrop of legacy workforce challenges. As companies seek fresh talent, the balance between innovation and experience remains a critical consideration.

themes.title: Defense Budgets Signal Strategic Shift
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup's $1.4 billion boost for space resilience reflects a growing acknowledgment of the strategic importance of space in national defense. This financial commitment may catalyze further advancements in space technology and infrastructure.
